commit_message: Finish ADR0154 validation and multi-skeleton preview
pr_title: Implement ADR 0154 target-aware animation motion binding
pr_body:
Completes the remaining ADR 0154 first-release repair work on the canonical Draft PR. Fixes the formal Windows Validation compile failure in package route planning, preserves current-main validation hygiene, resolves model-contained multi-skeleton Animation Set Target Preview routes from the selected animation's actual imported skin through the shared asynchronous preview residency/cache, distinguishes pending materialization from a real failed route, and shows Retarget map / Humanoid motion / Failed reason evidence next to the selected binding route. Adds synthetic multi-skeleton regression coverage and restores ADR 0154 as Accepted in the ADR index after syncing current main. Earlier commits in this PR already contain schema v3 candidate-only persistence, shared target-aware routing, import-owned portable HumanoidMotion provenance, Problems/build/play integration, packaging, mandatory AI-friendly authoring spec updates, and provenance/Target Preview contract tests. No third-party model or motion fixtures are introduced.

The PR remains Draft and must not be merged automatically.
